2026-07-06.themeBody: ISTELive 26's signature idea keeps generating coverage: EdTech Magazine and EdSurge unpack the six-role "AI-Ready Graduate" and a "relational intelligence" recap, Inside Higher Ed's RAISE US targets workforce reskilling, and 1EdTech advances research on scaling digital credentials.

2026-07-20.themeBody: Canvas paused data delivery over a potential security threat, while SonicWall found 61% of exploits land within 48 hours of proof-of-concept and 77% of organizations take over a week to patch.

2026-07-27.themeBody: The largest single cluster in today's sweep. EdTech Magazine's higher-ed desk runs security debt, managed providers as strategic partners, four AI-specific risk considerations, and CISOs translating risk into business value; Inside Higher Ed interviews Pathify's CISO on resilience; THE Journal reports that basic failures, not exotic attacks, still cause the breaches.

2026-08-03.themeBody: The recurring K-12 and campus IT message is that data governance, observability and an AI bill of materials come before the AI deployment, not after it. Districts collecting everything still can't say what their data means.
